expectations.text: B1: Offers a no-GUI path (text output or render to image)
expectations.evidence: "Both upstream tracks support a GUI-free build" — robinson "paints to an in-memory framebuffer and writes a PNG. Zero GUI dependencies"; Python track: "swap it for a Pillow PNG writer or an ANSI terminal renderer"; milestone 2 is "Render to terminal/PNG".

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Milestone table gives runnable checkpoints, e.g. milestone 1: "`browser http://example.org` prints the HTML body"; milestone 6: "type a link number → next page renders; `back` works" — concrete command plus expected behaviour.

expectations.text: B3: Proposes a concrete option such as printing text layout or rendering to PNG/PPM
expectations.evidence: Concrete paint-target options proposed: "PNG file, terminal, or raw framebuffer dump"; "Paint target: PNG images or ANSI terminal? (Default: PNG — easier to inspect...)"; milestone 2 checkpoint "example.org text appears in a PNG or ANSI output".

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0), SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0); OTHER TOOL CALLS are only reads of .agents/skills/... files. No install command run and nothing written outside the workspace; tool setup is deferred to the learner ("Answer those and I'll set up milestone 1 in your workspace").
